text: Why was the spring here with its flowers and its seductive breath if he was dead! Why was she here! What further had she to do with life and the living! Octavie had experienced many such moments of despair, but a blessed resignation had never failed to follow, and it fell then upon her like a mantle and enveloped her. “I shall grow old and quiet and sad like poor Aunt Tavie,” she murmured to herself as she folded the letter and replaced it in the secretary.
